function.name: StorePassword
function.description: Store a password entry for a specific website and username.

website.description: The website URL or name associated with the password.

username.description: The username associated with the password.

function.name: CheckPasswordStrength
function.description: Check the strength of a password based on length and character variety.

password.description: The password to check for strength.

function.name: GeneratePassword
function.description: Generate a random password with specified character types and strength level.

length.description: The desired length of the generated password.

include_symbols.description: Whether to include special symbols in the password.

include_numbers.description: Whether to include numeric digits in the password.

include_uppercase.description: Whether to include uppercase letters in the password.

include_lowercase.description: Whether to include lowercase letters in the password.

strength.description: The password strength level, must be 'weak', 'medium', or 'strong'.

function.name: AutoFillPassword
function.description: Auto-fill password for a specified website.

website.description: The website URL or name to retrieve password for.

function.name: SearchPasswords
function.description: Search for stored passwords by website or username.

query.description: The search query to match against website or username.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: StorePersonalInfo
function.description: Store personal information of a specific type.

info_type.description: The type of personal information, must be 'address' or 'payment'.

info_data.description: The personal information data to store.

function.name: AutoFillPersonalInfo
function.description: Auto-fill personal information for a specified website.

website.description: The website URL or name to fill information for.

info_type.description: The type of personal information, must be 'address' or 'payment'.

function.name: RetrievePersonalInfo
function.description: Retrieve stored personal information of a specific type.

info_type.description: The type of personal information to retrieve, must be 'address' or 'payment'.

function.name: SharePassword
function.description: Share a password entry with another contact.

website.description: The website URL or name associated with the password.

username.description: The username associated with the password.

contact_email.description: The email address of the contact to share with.

function.name: ImportPasswords
function.description: Import passwords from a JSON file.

file_path.description: The path to the JSON file containing password entries.

function.name: ExportPasswords
function.description: Export all stored passwords to a JSON file.

file_path.description: The path to save the exported password entries.

function.name: EnableTwoFactorAuthentication
function.description: Enable two-factor authentication with a phone number.

phone_number.description: The phone number to use for two-factor authentication.
